name: Long Walks on the Beach
summary: Izvi Glidfizz in Valormok asks you to search the eastern shore for Highborne treasure fragments. She hopes the scattered finds will bring a profit, even if they are worth more as metal than artifacts.

sections.title: A Shoreline Search
sections.body: Izvi Glidfizz in Valormok has a shovel of her own making and a plan for the eastern shore. The ruins there have been picked clean, but she believes valuable fragments remain beneath the sand. The naga make a long search impractical, so she sends you with the Treasure Trowel 3000 to gather what you can. She hopes to split the proceeds with you.

sections.title: The Find
sections.body: Izvi is pleased with what you bring back. She says the fragments may find no buyers as artifacts, but their metal can still be melted down and sold. The Treasure Trowel 3000 survives the search too, to her relief.

faq.answer: Izvi Glidfizz is the goblin in Valormok who made the Treasure Trowel 3000 and asks you to search the eastern shore.
The Treasure Trowel 3000 is Izvi Glidfizz's invention, an all-in-one treasure-detecting shovel.

faq.q: What is buried on the eastern shore?
faq.answer: Highborne treasure fragments lie beneath the sand on the eastern shore.

faq.q: Why does Izvi want the fragments?
faq.answer: Izvi hopes to split the profits with you. Even if the fragments do not sell as artifacts, she says their metal can be melted down and sold.

faq.q: Why does Izvi say searching is impractical?
faq.answer: Izvi says the naga make a long search along the shore impractical.
